lifecycleNotices.reason: The app-platform split supersedes this SDK-owned compatibility demonstration.
Replace URL-query endpoint and ion-token configuration with the approved secret-safe configuration surface before promotion.
Keep the workflow and add an isolated resettable live dataset.
Move browser credential inputs behind a host-mediated flow before recipe promotion.
Fold into the analysis journey while retaining this focused recipe.
Consolidate the imagery candidate and its overlapping recipes before journey qualification.
Retain as a renderer recipe and align it with the columnar large-data journey.
Remove the rejected browser credential variables from the supported configuration surface before journey qualification.
Use the same plan, provenance, approval, and evidence contracts as the agent journey.
Retain as the primary complete-application journey and simplify its first task.
Replace parity claims with renderer-specific execution and fidelity reports.
Become the universal discovery and explain-plan journey.
Join the large-data journey and distinguish fixture estimates from executed plans.
Fold into the imagery journey while keeping a focused STAC recipe.
Make this direct-public path the zero-account mode of the canonical quickstart.
Use its strongest interactions inside the imagery and 3D journey.
Combine point/profile proof with the imagery and 3D flagship.
Application-shell ownership moves to app-platform; preserve the realtime SDK journey separately.
Controls move with app-platform rather than remaining in the core SDK gallery.
